dict.string: SUBQUERY ( extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY ($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.text" ).@count >= 1 AND SUBQUERY ($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" ).@count <= 1 AND SUBQUERY ($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" ).@count <= 1 ).@count >= 1
